mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits aldehyde dehydrogenase and may potentiate cephalexin's disulfiram-like reaction if cephalexin contains a methylthiotetrazole side chain (though cephalexin has minimal risk compared to other cephalosporins).
action: Monitor for disulfiram-like reaction (flushing, nausea, vomiting, chest pain); counsel patient to avoid alcohol; cephalexin is considered lower risk than other cephalosporins with this combination.
